calculation.description: Ratio of 20-day return volatility to 60-day return volatility. Negative IC: assets whose short-term vol has compressed relative to their longer-term vol (calm after turbulence) earn higher forward 10d returns; recent 250d ICIR strongly negative confirms the low-vol-ratio signal.

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2020-01-01..2027-09-10 across regimes incl. 2020 COVID crash, 2021-22 tightening, 2023-24 AI rally, 2025-27 crypto/commodity cycles. Negative IC means low 20/60 vol ratio (recent calm) precedes outperformance. Recent 250 obs IC=-0.134 ICIR=-0.555: signal strengthened in the latest regime.
